// ADR-296 Phase 1 — the page file's repaired forms (E1 · E2 · E3 · E4 · E9 · E10 · E12 · token · object), generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr296Vocabulary.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {Button, Calendar, Form, ProgressBar, Text} from 'react-aria-components';
import {useListData} from 'react-aria-components/useListData';
import {capability, token} from '@composition/code';
import {queue} from '../Toast';
import usersData from './data/users';

export default function Home() {
  let [textIsVisible, setTextIsVisible] = useState(true);
  let formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  let users = useListData({
    initialItems: usersData,
    getKey: item => item.id
  });
  function onButtonPress() {
    setTextIsVisible(false);
  }
  function onButtonPress2() {
    formRef.current?.submit();
  }
  function onButtonPress3() {
    capability('hide', {target: null});
    users.append('u1', 'child');
    users.remove('u1');
  }

  return (
    <>
      {textIsVisible && <Text>Hi</Text>}
      <Form ref={formRef} />
      <ProgressBar label="Progress Bar" value={token('typography.text-xs')} />
      <Calendar visibleDuration={{months: 2}} />
      <Button onPress={() => { onButtonPress(); onButtonPress2(); onButtonPress3(); }} onHoverStart={() => {
        queue.add({title: 'hover'});
      }} />
    </>
  );
}
